text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just before the start of the Takarazuka 
Kinen, Meisho Doto came by the waiting 
room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her lack of self-confidence. Her respect 
for Admire Vega. Her admiration for T.M. 
Opera O. Having spoken of all of these—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having defeated Admire Vega once again, 
Meisho Doto declares that she will become 
the true rival to T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet Admire Vega cannot afford to lose 
either. For this is the Spring Grand Prix. 
It would undoubtedly become something her 
sister could be proud of.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Carrying the hopes and dreams of each 
runner, the curtain rises on the 
Takarazuka Kinen...
